title: Starlane SupportWorks
text:
Starlane SupportWorks

status_notes:
Post-demo engagement cooled off. Demo attended but no follow-up from product or procurement. Security asked for KMS/HSM detail and data-residency proof; passed to legal, then silence.

notes:
- 2025-01-15: Live demo (1h) with product + infra teams. Showed Hosted API latency profiles, fallback routing, batching knobs.
- Demo highlights: streaming chat, embeddings search demo for KB, example reranking flow.
- Ask from Starlane: VPC support, US-only residency, audit logs, integration with Okta SSO.
- On call they said: "we like the latency but need legal + security sign-off on KMS and retention".
- Post-demo: Sent POC scope + pricing 2025-01-16 (drive link above). Followed up 2025-01-22; no reply.
- AE note: Decision likely pushed to next quarter due to hiring/budget freeze. No clear champion after head of product left 2 weeks ago.
- Risk: competitor (Cohere) ran a faster pilot offering a seat-based discount; procurement referenced that in last thread.
- Internal summary: Good technical fit for support-agent flows; commercial timing uncertain. Recommend 2 more touches (SE note w/ technical appendix + cost-reduction options) then move to stale sequence.

recent_activities:
2024-11-06 - Initial qualification call (Maya Chen). Use-case: triage + KB search.
2024-12-12 - Security pre-screen questionnaire submitted (SE attached).
2025-01-08 - POC requirements workshop with product + infra (Liam O.).
2025-01-15 - Demo delivered (attended: CTO, Head of Product, SecOps).
2025-01-16 - POC scope + pricing sent (drive link).
2025-01-22 - AE follow-up email; no reply.

next_step:
Follow up (email) with trimmed POC scope + cost estimate; if no response in 2 weeks mark as stalled
